bills.c: Relating to the eligibility of property to receive an ad valorem tax exemption for property of a disabled veteran, the surviving spouse or minor children of a disabled veteran, or the surviving spouse and minor children of a member of the armed forces who dies while on active duty if the property is owned by a qualifying trust.
Relating to prohibiting members and representatives of designated foreign terrorist organizations from testifying at meetings of governmental entities.
Relating to retirement benefits for certain law enforcement officers who are members of the Teacher Retirement System of Texas, including the creation of a supplemental retirement program.
Relating to the definitions of certain terms for purposes of the exemption from ad valorem taxation of farm products in the hands of the producer.
Relating to rates for electric service provided to public school districts and other local governmental entities in certain counties.
Relating to the use by a political subdivision of public funds for lobbying activities.
Relating to public school instruction and courses in artificial intelligence system usage.

Relating to the protection and security of student information handled by contractors and subcontractors of public school districts and open-enrollment charter schools, including cybersecurity requirements, breach notification, contractual protections, and vendor liability; providing for civil penalties.
Relating to the use of average enrollment for purposes of the public school finance system.
Relating to a credit for prepayment of the amount required to be paid by a school district for the purchase of attendance credit under the public school finance system.
Relating to the sparsity adjustment for certain school districts under the Foundation School Program.
Relating to the eligibility of data centers and large data center projects to participate in certain incentive programs offered by the state and local governments.
Relating to providing free full-day prekindergarten for certain children.
Relating to the Internet broadcast or recording of certain open meetings.
Relating to the right of an employee to time off from work if the employee or employee's dependent is a victim of family violence.
Relating to establishing the Texas Seal of Biliteracy for public high school students.
Relating to purchase or other acquisition of personal property by a political subdivision.
Relating to maintenance and production of electronic public information under the public information law.
Relating to the immunization data included in and excluded from the immunization registry.
Relating to the reporting of a controlled substance overdose occurring on the campus of a public school.
Relating to the preservation and release of video and audio surveillance recordings of special education settings.
Relating to the provision of information regarding a local intellectual and developmental disability authority to the parents or guardians of certain special education students.
Relating to policies on the recess period in public schools.
Relating to the permissible uses of the school safety allotment under the Foundation School Program.
Relating to the essential knowledge and skills for the public school foundation curriculum and social studies curriculum.
Relating to public education and the public school finance system.
Relating to bullying and cyberbullying in public schools.
Relating to repealing the education savings account program.
Relating to a cost-of-living adjustment applicable to certain benefits paid by the Teacher Retirement System of Texas.
Relating to creating a fine arts allotment under the public school finance system.
Relating to standards adopted by the Texas Education Agency regarding the use of electronic devices and software applications by public schools.
Relating to public school bilingual education programs, dual language immersion programs, and special language programs.
Relating to Holocaust education and training for educators and students enrolled at public schools and public institutions of higher education.
Relating to requiring public schools to designate certain uniform election dates as staff development days.
